primary.title: Xtreme Winter 2026 — Hulvey & Anne Wilson
primary.imageSource: Xtreme Conferences official 2026 lineup flyer selected by owner
primary.description: Xtreme Winter 2026 in Gatlinburg: Hulvey performs during the 2026-12-30 evening session, scheduled for 7:30–10:00 PM EST. Anne Wilson is also scheduled in this evening session. Chapels Worship leads conference worship; Jerrod Gunter is the session speaker. DJ GBABY and Nich Oswald host the conference. This appearance is part of the December 29–31, 2026 student conference. The flyer shows the full conference roster; artists appear in different sessions. Conference-only registration is $99 for the full conference without lodging; the organizer does not advertise that price as a single-session ticket.
